test_GroupedBatchSampler_single_group: test GroupedBatchSampler with a single group id to verify all mini batches have the expected batch size
test_GroupedBatchSampler_multiple_groups: test GroupedBatchSampler with alternating group ids to verify samples from the same group are batched together
test_TrainingSampler_iterable_dataset: test TrainingSampler wrapped in ToIterableDataset with a DataLoader to verify all samples are yielded without duplicates
test_TrainingSampler_deterministic_seed: test TrainingSampler seed determinism to verify resetting the global RNG does not affect the sampler output
test_RepeatFactorTrainingSampler_categor: test RepeatFactorTrainingSampler repeat_factors_from_category_frequency to verify repeat factors are computed correctly from annotation category frequencies
